_about: nzmp.com — site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg). A /global/en-draft-0919 draft branch is publicly reachable (6 pages) and was rendered as part of the crawl.

multicolumn-grid.rationale: Multi-column grid of child components (text-icon cards, images, copy) → Columns; cells hold the child content.

responsivegrid-centered.rationale: Centered layout container (background image / colour variants) → EDS section + section-metadata style.

gridSection.rationale: Section wrapper with optional headline around dashboards/grids → EDS section with a heading.

richtext.rationale: Rich text (green-line / disclaimer styles) → default content; styles via section metadata.

variantRules.note: Rich text containing a <table> (nutrition / spec data) → Table block.

sectionheader.rationale: Centered section heading + intro → default content.

ctabuttonbannercomponent.rationale: 'How can we help?' strip with Explore ingredients / Contact us links on 209 pages → default-content heading + buttons in a soft-blue section.

downloadResource.rationale: Tracked resource download link (sf-ddl-link) → default-content link/button; keep the download analytics event.

textIconCard.rationale: Icon + heading + short copy card (460 instances) → Cards (icon variant).

statisticsTile.rationale: Large statistic ('4 in 10') with supporting copy, flex row → Cards (stat variant).

slicktiles.rationale: 'Learn more about NZMP' image tiles with link titles → Cards.

imageTextCard.rationale: Image + heading + copy + CTA card → Cards.

newsfeedInternalLinks.rationale: Row of linked image tiles → Cards.

tileListing.rationale: Product tiles (pack image, name, copy, format) with a 'View more' expander and an 'Interested?' CTA tile → Cards (show-more variant).

imageTextOverlay.rationale: Image beside heading + copy (image-badge left/right) → Columns.

variantRules.note: pageIntro variant (332 instances) = page intro banner → Hero.

mentions.rationale: Attributed quote ('We're seeing more growth…' — name, title) → Quote.

dashboard.rationale: Tabbed content (role=tablist / tab) switching product panels (Whey Protein, Milk Protein, …) on 162 pages → Tabs.

panel.rationale: Tab panel of the dashboard holding image-text-overlay + multicolumn product grids → Tabs panel content.

carouselSlide.rationale: Slide of a carousel → Carousel row.

verticalCarousel.rationale: Vertical slide carousel (featured tiles with image stack) → Carousel (vertical variant).

pageTeaser.rationale: 'Explore more ingredients like this' tile carousel (AEM list of pages, prev/next) on 277 pages → Carousel of cards (author-curated list).

expertsSlickSlider.rationale: Expert profile slider (photo, name, role, bio) → Carousel.

gallerycontainer.rationale: Image gallery of responsive images → Carousel (gallery variant).

responsive-youtube.rationale: YouTube thumbnail opening a modal player → Video (placeholder + modal).

webcastBanner.rationale: Webcast landing banner (title, date, CTA) → Hero.

next.rationale: 'Read next…' full-width slick rail of article cards on 289 article pages, selected per article at runtime → query-index driven related-articles block.

calltoaction.rationale: Locked 'Product Bulletin' / resource cards (padlock icon, modal trigger) on 193 pages — content gated behind myNZMP login or a lead form → custom gated-content block + auth/lead integration.

downloadSfDoc.rationale: 'Download' button opening a modal Salesforce lead form (name, email, company…) before releasing the document (36 pages) → custom gated download + Salesforce integration.

integratedContactForm.rationale: Site-wide modal contact form (310 pages): enquiry type, contact details, region/product selects, consent, reCAPTCHA → Salesforce. Custom form block + submission integration.

webcast.rationale: Webcast page: video iframe gated by an email registration form (reCAPTCHA) → custom block.

campaignGrid.rationale: Campaign tile listing beside an email signup form → custom block (form + listing).

emailSubscription.rationale: Email subscription form (name, email, consent) → custom form block.

dynamicform.rationale: Configurable table-layout form (dynamic fields) → custom form block + backend.

dynamicFormCapture.rationale: Dynamic lead-capture form → custom form block + backend.

carbonCertificateRequestForm.rationale: Carbon certificate request form (customer, order and product details) → custom form block + backend workflow.

textbox.rationale: Hidden form field inside the dynamic forms — part of the custom form block.

input.rationale: AEM Forms field — part of the custom form block.

hidden.rationale: AEM Forms hidden field — part of the custom form block.

options.rationale: AEM Forms checkbox options — part of the custom form block.

barIngredientsSelector.rationale: 'Not sure what ingredient is right for you?' bar-formulation wizard: step progress (bar type, ingredient category, protein/sugar, texture) with checkbox criteria → recommended NZMP solutions. Bespoke tool.

rtdSelector.rationale: Ready-to-drink beverage ingredient selector wizard (beverage type, macronutrient levels) → recommended solutions. Bespoke tool (same family as barIngredientsSelector).

cheeseselector.rationale: Cheese selector wizard in a modal → recommended cheese ingredients. Bespoke tool.

productselector.rationale: Product selector (filters → product tiles) → bespoke tool.

proteinCalculator.rationale: Protein calculator form (application, target protein %, selects) → computed recommendation. Bespoke calculation logic.

map.rationale: Interactive global office/plant map with region hotspots and a contact data table (desktop only) → custom block.

linkTableResellers.rationale: Reseller/distributor table filtered by region/product checkboxes → custom filterable list.

latestNews.rationale: Latest news listing with category filter dropdown and featured item → query-index listing block.

productListing.rationale: Filterable product listing (hidden filter state, facet buttons, product rows) → query-index driven listing block.

product-listing.rationale: Standalone product listing (tiles + text filter input) → query-index driven listing block.

algolia-search-bar.rationale: Algolia InstantSearch search box (third-party search service) → custom search block re-integrating Algolia (or replaced by EDS query-index search).

algolia-multilevel-facets-filter.rationale: Algolia multi-level facet filter (checkbox hierarchy) → part of the custom Algolia search block.

algolia-search-results.rationale: Algolia InstantSearch results (article cards, paging) → part of the custom Algolia search block.

navigation-links.rationale: Navigation link group → EDS header nav.

bannermenu.rationale: Banner menu (empty in publish) → part of the EDS header.
